texto.@es: Con **ask, tell, invite, encourage** y **want**, usa **verbo + persona + to + forma base**: **They invited us to join**; **The teacher encouraged the class to ask questions**.
texto.@en: With **ask, tell, invite, encourage** and **want**, use **verbo + persona + to + forma base**: **They invited us to join**; **The teacher encouraged the class to ask questions**.

texto.@es: La persona que hará la segunda acción va antes de **to**: **invite + us + to join**.
texto.@en: The person who will do the second action goes before **to**: **invite + us + to join**.

intro.@es: Para indicar qué quieres, pides o animas a hacer a otra persona, coloca su nombre o pronombre entre el verbo y **to + forma base**: **They invited us to join**.
intro.@en: To indicate what you want, ask for or encourage to do to another person, place your name or pronoun between the verb and **to + forma base**: **They invited us to join**.
